# Summit Marketing LLC

> Mississippi's AI-powered revenue growth agency — Reaching New Heights Together.

Summit Marketing LLC is a digital marketing and revenue systems agency based in Pearl, Mississippi, serving home service contractors and local businesses across Mississippi and the Southeast. Founded in 2026 by Nic Butts, Summit Marketing specializes in building automated lead capture, follow-up, and booking systems that help contractors stop losing jobs to slow response times and missed calls.

Our core philosophy: most contractors aren't losing because of a lack of leads — they're losing because they lack the right systems. We build the Revenue Engine that captures every lead, follows up in minutes, and books more jobs automatically.

## Founder

**Nic Butts** — Founder & CEO of Summit Marketing LLC. Nic spent 2+ years in the home services industry watching businesses lose jobs not from a lack of leads but from a lack of systems. He founded Summit Marketing to solve that problem — installing the complete Contractor Revenue Engine that ensures no lead falls through the cracks.

Contact: nic@summitmarketingms.com

## Services

Summit Marketing installs the **Contractor Revenue Engine** — a five-system approach to capturing, nurturing, and booking every lead:

1. **Lead Capture System** — Every call, form, and inquiry captured and routed automatically
2. **5-Minute Lead Response System** — Automated follow-up within 5 minutes of every inquiry
3. **AI Receptionist** — 24/7 AI trained on your company knowledge base that answers calls, qualifies leads, books appointments, and handles FAQs automatically
4. **Reputation System** — Automated review requests after every completed job
5. **Business Intelligence Dashboard** — Real-time visibility into lead flow, revenue, and system performance

### Retainer Plans (Monthly)

- **Basecamp** ($697/month + $1,500 onboarding): Lead Capture System, 5-Minute Lead Response, Missed Opportunity Recovery, Persistent Follow-Up Until They Book, Reputation System with automated review requests, Google Business Profile optimization, Local SEO foundation, Business Intelligence Dashboard. Ideal for contractors establishing their digital foundation.

- **Elevate** ($1,297/month + $2,000 onboarding): Everything in Basecamp, plus: Rank Higher on Google (SEO + AEO + GEO), Dominate Local Search, Own Your GBP, Build Local Authority, Reputation Management, Website Performance Monitoring.

- **Ascent** ($1,997/month + $3,000 onboarding — Most Popular): Everything in Elevate, plus: 24/7 AI Receptionist (Answers, Qualifies, Books), AI Sales Assistant, Website That Converts, Landing Pages Built to Book Jobs, Conversion Optimization, Advanced Business Intelligence Dashboard, Monthly Strategy Call. The complete Business Operating System for contractors.

- **Peak** ($3,250+/month — Custom): Everything in Ascent, plus: Estimate Recovery System, Lost Lead Recovery, Referral Automation, Seasonal Campaign Automation, Custom AI Knowledge Base, Full Social Media Management, Content Strategy + Video Editing, Multi-Location SEO Domination, Premium Authority Campaigns, Dedicated Strategy Partner, Priority Support.

Annual plans available at a discount (approximately 15% off).

### Web Design Services

- **Trailhead** ($300–$2,000): 5–10 page template-based website for contractors. Fast, mobile-first, conversion-optimized.
- **Pinnacle** ($2,000–$5,000): Fully custom-designed contractor website.
- **Apex** ($5,000–$20,000+): Complex builds including multi-location, custom integrations, advanced automation.

Every Summit site includes: conversion-first design, SEO from day one, Core Web Vitals optimization, GHL/CRM integration, and full marketing stack integration.

### AI & Automation Services

- **AI Receptionist**: Custom-trained AI that handles inbound calls, qualifies leads, books jobs, and answers FAQs 24/7 using your company's knowledge base
- **AI Sales Assistant**: Follows up on unbooked estimates, revives cold leads, and nurtures prospects automatically
- **Missed Opportunity Recovery**: Automated system that re-engages every lead that didn't book the first time
- **Referral Automation**: Systematically generates referrals from past clients on autopilot
- **Estimate Recovery System**: Re-engages unsold estimates with automated follow-up sequences

- **Jackson, MS** — Mississippi's capital city and largest market
- **Flowood, MS** — Rankin County hub

- **Brandon, MS** — Rankin County seat, fast-growing community
- **Gulfport, MS** — Mississippi Gulf Coast's largest city
- **Biloxi, MS** — Gulf Coast tourism and residential market
- **Hattiesburg, MS** — South Mississippi hub, university city

## What Makes Summit Marketing Different

Most marketing agencies sell you ad spend or SEO reports. Summit Marketing installs an end-to-end revenue system that works even when you're off the clock. The difference is a 5-minute response time vs. calling back the next day — and in contracting, the first company to respond wins the job.

Key differentiators:
- No paid advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads) — organic and AI-driven growth only
- Outcome-based pricing: you pay for booked jobs, not activity metrics
- Contractor-specific systems built around how home service businesses actually work
- AI-first: AI Receptionist and AI Sales Assistant included in Ascent and Peak plans
